statements.impact_statement: What: Suppresses CVE-2026-34040 (a Docker daemon authorization-plugin bypass) for docker-compose/docker-buildx; anchor entry for the docker/docker client-library-only group (CVE-2026-41567/42306 below share this background). Why: Vulnerable code not present -- the fix is daemon-side pkg/authorization middleware; these binaries embed github.com/docker/docker only as an API client library and never compile it. No fixed release exists at the pinned v28.5.2+incompatible module path (verified 2026-08-14 against both projects' vendored modules). From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Non-exploitability finding recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; re-verify on or before 2026-08-28 in case the underlying module pin or upstream situation has changed.)

What: Suppresses CVE-2026-41567 (a Docker daemon `docker cp`/archive- upload host code execution finding) for docker-compose/docker-buildx. Why: Same docker/docker client-library-only disposition as CVE-2026-34040 above. This is server-side request-handling code in the daemon's archive handler; docker/buildx's vendor/modules.txt vendors only pkg/namesgenerator, confirming the handler is absent (verified 2026-08-14). From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Non-exploitability finding recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; re-verify on or before 2026-08-28 in case the underlying module pin or upstream situation has changed.)

What: Suppresses CVE-2026-42306 (GHSA-rg2x-37c3-w2rh, a Docker daemon `docker cp` bind-mount race condition) for docker-compose/docker-buildx. Why: Same docker/docker client-library-only disposition as CVE-2026-34040 above. This is a race condition in the daemon's own `docker cp` implementation; confirmed absent by the same vendor/modules.txt check (verified 2026-08-14). From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Non-exploitability finding recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; re-verify on or before 2026-08-28 in case the underlying module pin or upstream situation has changed.)

statements.action_statement: What: Accepts CVE-2026-12064 (an SSH host-verification bypass via schemeless SFTP/SCP URLs) as tracked risk for `tools/build-tools`'s `curl`/`libcurl4t64`/`libcurl3t64-gnutls` package. Anchor entry for this file's curl group (CVE-2026-8286/8927/8932/9079/9080/9545 below). Why: Trivy reports `Status: affected`, `FixedVersion: None`; no `paths:` scoping applies since Trivy's Debian os-pkgs finding class carries no `PkgPath`. `tools/build-tools`'s own curl usage is exclusively `curl -fsSL` against pinned GitHub-release URLs, never a schemeless SFTP/SCP URL. The 5 Alpine-based runtime images run curl 8.21.0 and show 0 findings (verified 2026-08-14, lancache-240). From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Accepted, tracked risk recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; this disposition expires 2026-08-28 and must be re-reviewed on or before that date.)

What: Accepts CVE-2026-8286 (an insecure TLS-configuration-mismatch connection issue) as tracked risk for `tools/build-tools`'s curl package. Why: Same curl finding group as CVE-2026-12064 above; `Status: affected`, severity HIGH on `tools/build-tools`, absent from the Alpine-based runtime images (verified 2026-08-14, lancache-240). From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Accepted, tracked risk recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; this disposition expires 2026-08-28 and must be re-reviewed on or before that date.)

From: Issue #1304, PR #1548 (Accepted, tracked risk recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; this disposition expires 2026-08-28 and must be re-reviewed on or before that date.)

statements.impact_statement: What: Marks CVE-2011-4116 (`perl-base`'s `File::Temp` module creating temporary files insecurely) as not exploitable in `services/ui` and `tools/build-tools`. Anchor entry for a 30-ID group spanning the Debian `perl-base`, util-linux, ncurses, `gzip`, and `libacl1` package groups. Why: All 30 are `Priority: required`/`Essential: yes` Debian packages or their hard link-time dependents, so none can be purged; "not exploitable" is the only available disposition short of migrating the image off Debian. Neither image invokes Perl at all (grep-confirmed; re-verified 2026-08-19 against the current tree). From: Issue #815, PR #1454, Issue #1598 (Non-exploitability finding recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; re-verify on or before 2026-08-27 in case the underlying module pin or upstream situation has changed.)

statements.action_statement: What: Accepts CVE-2026-41991 (an arbitrary-file-overwrite via insecure temporary-file handling in the `gzexe` utility) as tracked risk for `tools/build-tools` only; `services/ui` is unaffected. Anchor entry for the 2-ID gzip group (this and CVE-2026-41992 below) -- the only ID in this file's 30-ID batch where the two images' exploitability genuinely differs. Why: `services/ui` never invokes `gzip`/`gzexe` (grep-confirmed). Trivy's finding applies per-CVE-ID repo-wide with no per-image `paths:` scoping for Debian os-pkgs, so the disposition reflects the more exploitable image: `tools/build-tools` unpacks pinned, checksum-verified release tarballs via `gzip`, never invoking `gzexe` itself or on attacker-supplied input. No `trixie`/ `trixie-backports` fix exists yet (Debian security-tracker: only `sid` has 1.14-1; re-verified 2026-08-19). From: Issue #815, PR #1454, Issue #1598 (Accepted, tracked risk recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; this disposition expires 2026-08-27 and must be re-reviewed on or before that date.)

What: Accepts CVE-2026-41992 (a global buffer overflow in gzip's own LZH decompression path -- legacy `.lzh`/SCO-compress-format support) as tracked risk for `tools/build-tools` only; the HIGH-severity ID in this group. Why: Same gzip finding group as CVE-2026-41991 above. `tools/build-tools`'s `gzip` usage (unpacking plain `.tar.gz` tarballs) never exercises the LZH code path, which only triggers on input explicitly identified as LZH-formatted. From: Issue #815, PR #1454, Issue #1598 (Accepted, tracked risk recorded in .trivyignore.yaml; this disposition expires 2026-08-27 and must be re-reviewed on or before that date.)
